name: Meeting Brief Assistant
summary: Sends a Slack brief with attendee history, PDF agenda summaries, and talking points before every calendar meeting.

items.title: Google calendar sync
items.description: Reads upcoming meetings from your calendar to trigger brief preparation.
items.proved_when: Upcoming calendar events are fetched successfully
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

items.title: Last email thread per attendee
items.description: Finds the most recent email thread with each meeting participant.
items.proved_when: Email threads for attendees are retrieved successfully

items.title: Agenda PDF summariser
items.description: Reads attached PDF agendas from calendar invites and summarises them.
items.proved_when: PDF text is parsed and summarised successfully
items.source_quote: a summary of any attached agenda PDF

items.title: Talking points generator
items.description: Generates three relevant talking points based on emails and agenda.
items.proved_when: Three talking points are generated for the meeting

items.title: Slack brief sender
items.description: Delivers the prepared meeting brief to Slack.
items.proved_when: Message is posted successfully to Slack

items.title: Brief timing schedule
items.description: Triggers brief generation before each meeting starts.
items.proved_when: Briefs are sent prior to meeting start time
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar
